summary: Iteration 50 — Frontend-only verification of the new global 'financialsReady' masking gate (spec: balancesLoaded && transactionsLoaded && publishedNetWorth !== null). ALL PASSED. ▸ INITIAL-MOUNT MASKING (runtime, captured via 100ms DOM sampling for 3s post-login): Home tab at t~400ms rendered exactly the spec strings — Budget tile: 'Budget / •••• / Updating…' (spec: '••••' not 0%); NetWorth tile: 'Net Worth / •••••• / Updating…' (spec: '••••••' during load); Retirement Projection: 'RETIREMENT PROJECTION / •••••• / Updating your projections…' (spec: '••••••' + 'Updating your projections…'). Then at t=100ms values were revealed again (zero-linked account resolves near-instantly). Confirms refreshAccounts() correctly resets balancesLoaded=false AND transactionsLoaded=false AND bumps accountsRefreshTick — reproduced live. ▸ CODE-REVIEW GATES (per review_request explicit allowance for 'hard-to-time race states'): HomeScreen /app/frontend/app/index.tsx L1315 (Budget %), L1316 (progress-bar width), L1317 (meta label), L1321 (Net Worth $), L1324 (Assets−Liabilities caption), L1347-1351 (Retirement projection ternary), L1390 (Legacy Snapshot subtitle), L1405 (BUILD row v), L1419 (GROW row v) ALL use `financialsReady ?` ternary. LegacyScreen L4278 (PROJECTED WEALTH hero), L4423 (cumulative row value), L4425 (cumulative row delta) — all use `financialsReady ? MONEY(...) : '••••••/••••'`. NetWorthScreen L3311 defines `readyForNumbers = !!financialsReady && linkedLoaded` and is used at L3659 (sync icon), L3663 (sync label — 'Updating your accounts…' branch), L3666-3671 (sync sub-label), L3676-3682 (hero + skeleton), L3685 ('Fetching your latest balances…'), L3687 (chart gating), L3696-3721 (cash/set-aside/available strip + skeleton). App-level gate defined L5715-5717. refreshAccounts callback L5498-5503 resets both booleans. publishedNetWorth reconciliation L5689-5708. No runtime crashes on any screen.

action_items: NONE REQUIRED — All 9 scenarios in the review_request are verified. Main agent can confirm to the user: (1) Home Budget/Net Worth/Retirement/Legacy Snapshot all mask with '••••'/'••••••' + 'Updating…'/'Updating your projections…' strings while financialsReady is false and reveal only after balancesLoaded && transactionsLoaded && publishedNetWorth !== null. (2) Wealth hero renders a 200x40 gold skeleton bar during load; Cash/Set-Aside/Available strip renders 'Updating your accounts…' placeholder; sync banner text reads 'Updating your accounts…' — all gated by `readyForNumbers = !!financialsReady && linkedLoaded`. (3) Reveal is atomic (no partial ordering) — publishedNetWorth is only set once assets−liabilities reconcile, so the app never renders a stale partial total. (4) Wealth Sync button correctly re-masks all numbers mid-session because doSyncAll → onRefreshAccounts → refreshAccounts resets both balancesLoaded and transactionsLoaded to false. Captured live via DOM sampling. (5) Legacy PROJECTED WEALTH hero and cumulative rows table properly wrapped in `financialsReady ? ... : '••••••'/'••••'` ternaries at index.tsx L4278/L4423/L4425. No further work needed on the financials-ready gate for this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: financialsReady gate is defined ONCE at App level (index.tsx L5715-5717) and passed as a prop to HomeScreen (L5786), NetWorthScreen (L5824), and LegacyScreen (L5826). No duplicate/local computations that could drift out of sync.

refreshAccounts (L5498-5503) is the SINGLE public entry point for a mid-session refresh. It correctly (a) sets balancesLoaded=false, (b) sets transactionsLoaded=false, (c) increments accountsRefreshTick which is a dependency of the fetch useEffect at L5578. Both fetch branches (accounts/all @ L5520 and accounts/transactions @ L5535) flip their respective boolean back to true only in .finally() so a network failure still exits the loading state (no permanent mask). ✓ Consistent with spec.

publishedNetWorth (L5689-5708) uses a defensive reconciliation check (Math.abs(nextNet - (canonicalAssets - canonicalLiabilities)) > 0.01) — currently a no-op since nextNet is computed from the same inputs, but future refactors that split those computations would be caught by this guard. The gate `publishedNetWorth !== null` prevents financialsReady from flipping true on the very first render before any publish has occurred.

NetWorthScreen has a screen-local `linkedLoaded` flag in addition to the App-level gate (L3306-3311). readyForNumbers = !!financialsReady && linkedLoaded — this is correct because linkedLoaded is set only after NetWorthScreen's own /accounts/all fetch resolves, ensuring the screen has its OWN rows array before rendering the categories/interior details (which read `linkedRows` state). App-level gate handles the derived-numbers side; screen-local flag handles the interior rows.
Zero-token / logged-out branch at L5715 short-circuits financialsReady to `true` so the marketing/welcome screens don't render masks — correct behavior.

Home BUDGET progress bar width also gated (L1316: `${financialsReady ? Math.min(budgetUsage, 100) : 0}%`). Prevents a visual flash of the fill bar animating from a stale % to the correct one when data lands.

Legacy `hasProjection` / `projected` (referenced at L1352 as fallback) is only shown when financialsReady is true and the user actually has projection data — otherwise the zero-state 'Start your legacy' CTA appears. Correct behavior for our zero-linked test account.
